This method is taken into account if it is called before FGFDMExec::RunIC() otherwise it is ignored until the next call to SetStartNewOutput().

briefdescription.para: Implements the output to a socket.

detaileddescription.para: This class outputs data to a socket according to the JSBSim format. It can be inherited as a generic class that provides services for socket outputs. For instance FGOutputFG inherits FGOutputSocket for the socket management but outputs data with a format different than FGOutputSocket.
